title: TimezoneDB API Vocabulary
description: Domain vocabulary for the TimezoneDB API covering timezone data concepts, parameters, and response fields.

terms.label: Zone Name
terms.description: An IANA timezone database identifier that uniquely names a geographic timezone. Examples: America/New_York, Europe/London, Asia/Tokyo.

terms.label: Timezone Abbreviation
terms.description: A short code representing a timezone, often reflecting the offset and DST status. Examples: CDT (Central Daylight Time), CST (Central Standard Time), EST.

terms.label: GMT Offset
terms.description: The offset from UTC/GMT in seconds. Positive values indicate timezones east of UTC; negative values indicate timezones west of UTC.

terms.label: Daylight Saving Time
terms.description: A flag indicating whether Daylight Saving Time is currently in effect. 0 means no DST, 1 means DST is active. Returned as integer in list-time-zone and as string in get-time-zone.

terms.label: Unix Timestamp
terms.description: A point in time represented as the number of seconds elapsed since the Unix epoch (January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC).

terms.label: Formatted Datetime
terms.description: A human-readable local datetime string in Y-m-d H:i:s format (year-month-day hours:minutes:seconds).

terms.label: Zone Start
terms.description: Unix timestamp marking when the current timezone period (including DST or standard time rule) began.

terms.label: Zone End
terms.description: Unix timestamp marking when the current timezone period will end. A value of -1 indicates no scheduled end.

terms.label: Next Abbreviation
terms.description: The timezone abbreviation that will apply after the current period ends at zoneEnd.

terms.label: Country Code
terms.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 two-letter country code identifying the country associated with a timezone.

terms.label: Country Name
terms.description: Full English name of the country associated with a timezone.

terms.label: Region Name
terms.description: The name of the region or state within a country. Available as a premium feature.

terms.label: City Name
terms.description: The name of the city or locality. Available as a premium feature.

terms.label: Timezone Offset
terms.description: In the context of time zone conversion, the difference in seconds between the origin timezone and the destination timezone. Positive means destination is ahead.

terms.label: Lookup Method
terms.description: The method used to identify a timezone in get-time-zone requests. Options are: zone (by name/abbreviation), position (by lat/lng), city (by city name and country), or ip (by IP address).

terms.label: Latitude
terms.description: Geographic latitude coordinate in decimal degrees. Ranges from -90 (South Pole) to 90 (North Pole).

terms.label: Longitude
terms.description: Geographic longitude coordinate in decimal degrees. Ranges from -180 to 180, with positive values east of the prime meridian.

terms.label: Response Status
terms.description: The result status of an API query. 'OK' indicates success; 'FAILED' indicates an error occurred.

terms.label: Response Message
terms.description: A human-readable message accompanying the status. Empty string on success; contains error description on failure.
